subject: Save request: Skyward Systems renewal — make-good & term ask
messages:
From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@skyward.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Pike <jordan.pike@skyward.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal — urgent: request for make-good and term reset

Ben / Jordan,

Quick summary: our renewal is live but usage has fallen 28% QoQ while our contract rates remained fixed. This year we budgeted tighter and the board wants to re-evaluate platform spend. We value Redwood but are being pushed to consider other vendors unless we can get a short-term accommodation.

What we are asking for:
- One-time make-good credit equal to ~25% of our next invoice to cover recent downtime/usage shortfall
- Reset the contract term to a 12-month window (current contract auto-renews for 36 months) so we can re-assess after 12 months
- Include a 6-month SLA premium (99.9% uptime commitment) at no additional charge while we stabilize.

Attached: skyward_usage_report_Q4.pdf (high-level usage and incidents).

We need a formal concession proposal by end of next week (2026-12-17) or procurement will escalate to alternatives. Happy to jump on a call.

—Leah Ortiz
Head of Infrastructure, Skyward Systems
leah.ortiz@skyward.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@skyward.ai>, Jordan Pike <jordan.pike@skyward.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — urgent: request for make-good and term reset

Leah — thanks for the note and the report. I’m sorry to hear usage and perception slipped; we want to keep Skyward on Redwood. I attached a provisional save package (proposed_save_package_v3.pdf) that reflects an initial counter we can offer while I request exec sign-off for anything beyond standard playbook.

Quick ask: can you confirm the renewal execution deadline from your side (procurement timeline) and whether the make-good should show as a credit on the next invoice or a separate rebate? I’ll escalate for approval — Vivek, looping you in to advise next steps for concession authority.

Proposed by AE (informal): 15% one-time credit + 6 months SLA premium at no charge + term reset to 12 months conditional on renewing by 2026-12-24. Will need finance/legal sign-off.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal — urgent: request for make-good and term reset — exec approval request

Ben — thanks for the context. I reviewed the usage file. Skyward is a strategic platform account with clear expansion potential in '27; losing them now would risk $1.2M ARR over 12 months and create churn signal for similar accounts.

Ask to leadership (Marissa): authorization to approve a modified save package beyond standard playbook. Specifics:
- Customer requests 25% credit; recommend approving a one-time 15% credit (applied to next invoice)
- Approve term reset to 12 months (from auto-renew 36) to give customer flexibility; require re-eval pricing at 6 months
- Approve a 6-month SLA premium (99.9%) at no charge as a temporary uplift

Conditions: require renewal executed and payment terms met by 2026-12-24. All concessions subject to finance confirmation of net ARR impact.

Marissa — please advise if you can grant this authority or whether we should escalate to CRO for one-off higher concession.

Vivek
Head of Sales Ops (acting)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-11T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal — urgent: request for make-good and term reset — exec approval request

Thanks for the clear summary. I authorize a controlled save package with the following limits:
- One-time credit: 15% of the next invoice (apply as a credit line item)
- Term reset: move to a 12-month committed term (with standard renewal language) — pricing will be re-evaluated after 6 months; any further concessions require CRO sign-off
- SLA: provide the 6-month SLA premium (99.9%) at no charge, but include a performance remediation clause in the amendment

Conditions: legal to confirm amendment language; finance must sign off on revenue recognition impact and credit mechanics. This approval is conditional on final signed amendment by 2026-12-24. No additional discounts beyond this package without explicit CRO approval.

Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal approval — finance input required

Marissa / Ben — finance here. Quick items we need before we finalize:
1) Exact credit amount in dollars (15% of which invoice? please provide MRR snapshot used)
2) Revenue impact schedule (how the credit posts, one-time vs amortized)
3) Confirmation that the SLA add-on has no recurring charge after 6 months or, if it does, what the run-rate will be

Please send the redlined amendment and the updated quote. I’ll sign off once we confirm the net ARR impact.

—Mina Haddad
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@skyward.ai>, Jordan Pike <jordan.pike@skyward.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final save package & next steps (DL-2026-7893)

Leah / Jordan — appreciate the quick responses. Per Marissa’s approval I’m attaching the redlined amendment (redlined_terms_skyward.docx) that implements: 15% one-time credit (applied to next invoice), 12-month term reset, and 6-month SLA premium at no charge with remediation clause.

Mina — attached the MRR snapshot and a proposed amortization schedule for the credit. Please confirm and I’ll route to legal for signature.

Next steps:
- Procurement to confirm execution timeline (need signed amendment by 2026-12-24)
- Finance sign-off on credit mechanics
- Legal to produce final amendment for signature

If Skyward can confirm approval on the attached by EOD Monday (2026-12-14), we’ll expedite legal to get this across the finish line.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
attachments: redlined_terms_skyward.docx, proposed_save_package_v3.pdf
